headline: Don’t screw this up, Marvel
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day earned $1 billion worldwide in its opening week. It broke box office records, becoming Hollywood's biggest opening weekend. The film highlights Sony's continued hold on Spider-Man rights and Marvel's smart collaboration.

headline: Now you can securely link multiple phones to one Signal account
summary: Signal now allows users to link multiple phones to a single account. This new feature extends multi-device support beyond PCs and iPads. Users can sync messages and respond across all linked Androids and iPhones.

headline: AMD’s data center business is booming while gaming takes a backseat
summary: AMD's data center revenue more than doubled to $6.7 billion, driven by AI demand. This marks a 107% increase year-over-year for the segment. Gaming revenue is taking a secondary role compared to the surging data center growth.

headline: SpaceX made more revenue as an AI company than a space company
summary: SpaceX's AI division generated $2.6 billion, tripling its revenue year-over-year. The company earned more from AI services than its traditional space operations. AI revenue primarily comes from providing compute power to other AI firms.

headline: Save $750 Off Gigabyte's Flagship AORUS Master Gaming Laptop With GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Graphics
summary: Gigabyte's flagship AORUS Master Gaming Laptop is available with a $750 discount. The powerful laptop features GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Graphics. This premium gaming machine is now significantly more affordable.

headline: Original Grand Tour Hosts Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond, and James May Will Cameo in the New Season
summary: The original Grand Tour hosts, Clarkson, Hammond, and May, will cameo in the new season. The iconic trio will appear alongside the show's new presenters. Fans can expect to see the former Top Gear stars return to the series.

headline: Joke Game Priced at 200 Dollars Rakes In $1.3 Million on Steam Before Thousands of Players Refund It
summary: A joke game, "This Game Costs 200 Dollars," earned $1.3 million on Steam. The teen developer saw massive revenue before mass refunds. Thousands of players ultimately returned the game for their money.

headline: The Popular Budget-Friendly Flashforge Adventurer 5M 3D Printer Drops to a Mere $135 Shipped
summary: The popular Flashforge Adventurer 5M 3D Printer is now priced at just $135. This deal offers a budget-friendly option for an entry-level 3D printer. It's considered one of the best deals for a solid, affordable 3D printing device.

headline: Burnham 'looking into' conducting Epstein enquiry, says victims minister
summary: Victims Minister Alex Davies-Jones stated Burnham is considering an Epstein inquiry. Davies-Jones discussed the potential inquiry with the Prime Minister. The move signals a possible official investigation into the Epstein case.

headline: Temperatures to drop briefly ahead of next UK heatwave
summary: UK temperatures and humidity are forecast to drop temporarily. This brief respite will precede another impending heatwave. The period of cooler weather is expected to be short-lived.

headline: Dewormer and scabies drugs being sold as cancer treatments, BBC investigation finds
summary: A BBC investigation found dewormer and scabies drugs marketed as cancer treatments. A terminally-ill man was targeted by a salesman making false claims. The investigation uncovers dangerous and unethical medical misinformation.

headline: The avalanche that killed a climbing legend - and a generation of record-setting guides
summary: An avalanche in Pakistan killed a climbing legend and multiple record-setting guides. The incident dealt a devastating blow to Nepal's mountaineering community. Fellow guides mourn the significant loss of an entire generation of experts.
